excerpts.label: Consumer struggling, zero job growth
excerpts.insight: Economy shows zero job growth—not crisis but not good. Consumer weak on jobs, wages, spending.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Fade the soft landing narrative. Zero job growth + weak consumer = buy equity puts on rallies. Don't get long risk here.

excerpts.label: AI is everything—the only engine
excerpts.insight: AI capex in info equipment/software is the sole growth driver; housing not responding to lower mortgage spreads
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Underweight hyperscalers—they're the concentration risk. If AI capex slows, there's no second engine. Own semis over software.

excerpts.label: Fed will cut more than priced
excerpts.insight: Disinflation + slowing economy = Fed should and will cut beyond expectations—not because of dovish chair
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY SOFR. Market is underpricing cuts by 50-75bps. This is Andy's highest conviction call—Fed cuts because they should, not because chair is dovish.

excerpts.label: Steepener is principal risk trade
excerpts.insight: Short long-term bonds, long front-end; 10Y puts + SOFR; don't chase gold here
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STEEPENERS NOW. Buy 10Y puts, stay long SOFR. This is the first thing Andy's adding to. Gold is a pass at these levels—too elevated to chase.

excerpts.label: 2-10s to 95-100bps, evil twist
excerpts.insight: Jimmy sees 2s breaking lower as 10s break higher—potential twist to 4.35-4.40% tens
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Target 2-10s at 95-100bps. Expect a TWIST not a parallel move—2s rally while 10s dump to 4.35-4.40%. No foreign bid, no policy support for long end.
